checks.method: Parsed every path-ownership row, verified shard bytes/SHA256/row counts, primary owner, blob, mode and size against pinned full tree; directory entries remain separately censused.

Recursively compared exact path, Git object/type, mode, size when declared and source commit in all seven registries against pinned tree; tree refs were treated as trees, not mistaken for missing files.

Checked unique IDs; domain/need/flow/artifact/case references; all artifact build edges point to existing strictly earlier layers, hence acyclic; barrier membership equals full artifact set for each layer. Navigation refs remain non-invalidating; semantic sufficiency of individual edge choices is not established.

Every required artifact has its bound direct-use case; each domain has all five AC-02 public intent families; positive byte/query limits and query sum checked. Hidden expected answers remain pending S5, not inferred from public intent.

Computed exact pinned population for .atlas/.git path segments, symlinks and size >256000. Re-read real ownership-input observer for present/absent/unavailable, legacy projection, symlink refusal, NUL Git membership and retained unavailable state. Alternate S2 capture is a prerequisite, never an implemented claim.

Compared final platform domains/selected merged flows against original author fragment and known source observations: Rag Studio README/export mismatch retained; Janitor presenter does not prove scanner wiring; frozen Relay goldens and historical Omni qualification retain bounded status; whole-repo primary ownership includes module/native/ops/history areas.

Contract keeps source/protocol/prompt/candidate identities separate, complete layer release behind two S5 decisions, pre-evaluation oracles, governed publication and unavailable runtime blockers. Core guard symbols and Database.Service occur in cached actual source; native ChatGPT route is explicitly outside that guard and AC-08 remains open. No execution or monetary guarantee inferred.
